_source: CBP ruling N348298 (21 May 2025): electric water filter dispenser, South Korean carbon block, other parts Chinese, assembled in China: CBP held China. In the selection pool; excluded. Plant capabilities for South Korea are an assumption.

product.name: Electric water filter dispenser
product.description: A countertop dispenser made of a transparent water tank, a tank lid and a water pumping unit; the pumping unit holds a circuit board, a battery and a carbon block filter element.

components.name: transparent water tank and tank lid
water pumping unit with circuit board, battery and touch panel

operations.name: assemble the filter element, fit it into the pumping unit, fit the pumping unit to the tank and lid, test and pack

economics.duty_rates_note: Illustrative placeholder, not a sourced rate.
